reassessment_trigger: Reassess before BARCODE_LOOKUP_PROVIDER is ever set, or if the web container's egress route is restored; either change reopens the DNS-rebinding path this acceptance assumes is unreachable.
Reassess if mail infrastructure is ever introduced; a self-service reset flow would then need to be built with the second factor enforced.
Reassess if inventory/share mutation is extended beyond the authenticated owner acting on their own data.
Reassess if concurrent writers to the same session/dataset increase, or revocation semantics change.

At the first non-local deployment, confirm route A (front with an existing TLS-terminating reverse proxy) or route B (mount an externally issued certificate) is actually configured, not merely documented as available; record in docs/security/HOSTED-READINESS.md.
Reassess once certificate-based backend authentication is built on the now-closed internal-TLS channel (D-42), or sooner if the credential file's mount/permissions change.
Closes when the planned secrets-manager integration ships; otherwise revisit no later than expiry.
Reassess if PDF/document metadata stripping is implemented, or if uploaded documents start being re-shared outside their original uploader.
Reassess when host NTP/log evidence is collected for a non-local deployment; purely an operator obligation with no code path in this repository to close it.
Reassess when host-level stdout log protection and retention evidence is recorded; the database half is already covered by make verify-db-roles.
Closes when the planned log-shipping/alerting feature ships; otherwise revisit no later than expiry.
As soon as ghcr.io/crow50/doom-organizer:0.2.0 is confirmed published, re-run the ledger and mark this finding closed against the new image's own SBOM/scan rather than renewing the exception.
